title: N3 · Unit 16

lessons.title: Read a news brief with its source and date
lessons.description: Retrieve reported speech and causes in an original local-news brief.
lessons.canDo: Distinguish a past decision, a reported future event and a historical count

lessons.title: Use the timetable without mixing its quantities
lessons.description: Retrieve decisions, comparison and conditions to choose a fitting activity.
lessons.canDo: Find an activity, cost and deadline while keeping capacity separate from attendance

grammar.title: Keep the source attached to the report
grammar.formation: Retrieve source によると + plain proposition + そうだ/そうです. Noun/na-adjective retains だ before reported そうだ.
grammar.explanation: Identify who supplied a reported statement and when. A report of a future event does not mean the event has already taken place. Reported 開催するそうだ retains する; appearance 開催しそうだ uses the stem and has a different basis. Earlier source/observation lessons remain relevant. No numerical confidence ranking is assigned.
grammar.example: 記者によると、展示は無料だそうです。
grammar.translation: According to the reporter, the exhibition is free.

examples.ja: {記者|きしゃ}によると、{展示|てんじ}は{無料|むりょう}だそうです。
examples.en: According to the reporter, the exhibition is free.

examples.ja: {記事|きじ}には、{土曜日|どようび}に{開催|かいさい}するそうだと{書|か}いてある。
examples.en: The article says it is reportedly being held on Saturday.

examples.ja: {見出|みだ}しだけでなく、{本文|ほんぶん}も{読|よ}むそうです。
examples.en: They say they will read the main text as well as the headline.

grammar.mistake: Do not drop noun だ or confuse a reported future arrangement with a completed event.

grammar.title: Read a stated cause without inventing a motive
grammar.formation: Retrieve noun + のため; na-adjective + なため; attributive clause + ため. In a notice, に may be omitted. Purpose ために needs a goal context.
grammar.explanation: A stated cause explains an outcome in the article. 施設の修理のため、会場を変えた reports a reason for changing venue; it is not an intention to make the repair happen. Tense alone does not decide cause versus purpose. Preserve the source’s scope and do not infer a different cause, such as noise or weather, from nearby vocabulary.
grammar.example: 施設の修理のため、会場を変えた。
grammar.translation: The venue was changed because of repairs to the facility.

examples.ja: {施設|しせつ}の{修理|しゅうり}のため、{会場|かいじょう}を{変|か}えた。
examples.en: The venue was changed because of repairs to the facility.

examples.ja: {見出|みだ}しが{短|みじか}いため、{本文|ほんぶん}で{条件|じょうけん}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.en: Because the headline is short, check the conditions in the main text.

examples.ja: {地域|ちいき}について{知|し}るために、{記事|きじ}を{読|よ}む。
examples.en: Read the article in order to learn about the area.

grammar.mistake: A repair cause is not a purpose, and the future event is not confirmed merely by being reported.

grammar.title: A venue decision is not an attended event
grammar.formation: Retrieve V-dictionary/ない + ことになった for a resulting arrangement; V-dictionary/ない + ことにした for a deliberate choice.
grammar.explanation: The organiser arranged to use an indoor hall on Monday; the learner chooses on Thursday to read the panel descriptions. Neither past decision form establishes attendance at Saturday’s event. する/なる is a framing distinction, not a universal inside/outside decision test. This retrieves unit 6 rather than silently adding ことになっている.
grammar.example: 屋内の施設で開催することになった。
grammar.translation: It was arranged that the event would be held indoors.

examples.ja: {屋内|おくない}の{施設|しせつ}で{開催|かいさい}することになった。
examples.en: It was arranged that the event would be held indoors.

examples.ja: {無料|むりょう}の{展示|てんじ}を{先|さき}に{見|み}ることにした。
examples.en: I decided to see the free exhibition first.

examples.ja: {翌日|よくじつ}には{開催|かいさい}しないことになった。
examples.en: It was arranged that the event would not be held the following day.

grammar.mistake: Changing the plan is not attending it; not doing an action is distinct from not making a decision.

grammar.title: Compare the same quantity and the same period
grammar.formation: Retrieve AはBほど…ない and AよりBのほうが…. State the measured quantity, dates and population before comparing.
grammar.explanation: A tally of last year’s visitors is a count of completed visits. This year’s lecture capacity is a limit, not actual attendance, and an application count is not an attendance count either. Compare like quantities before describing increase/decrease. A smaller capacity does not prove fewer people attended this year.
grammar.example: 去年の午後の人数は、午前ほど多くなかった。
grammar.translation: Last year’s afternoon count was not as large as its morning count.

examples.ja: {去年|きょねん}の{午後|ごご}の{人数|にんずう}は、{午前|ごぜん}ほど{多|おお}くなかった。
examples.en: Last year’s afternoon count was not as large as its morning count.

examples.ja: {一昨年|おととし}より{去年|きょねん}の{来場|らいじょう}{者|しゃ}の{方|ほう}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.en: Last year had more visitors than the year before that.

examples.ja: {定員|ていいん}と{来場|らいじょう}{者|しゃ}の{合計|ごうけい}は{同|おな}じものではない。
examples.en: Capacity and the total visitor count are not the same kind of quantity.

grammar.mistake: A table heading supplies scope. Do not compare future capacity with past attendance as a measured trend.

grammar.title: Apply the stated conditions to the right activity
grammar.formation: Retrieve noun + さえあれば or Vば for a sufficient condition within the stated situation. Distinguish a deadline までに from a duration まで.
grammar.explanation: The free exhibition needs no application. The charged lecture requires prior admission and its ticket; ticket possession is sufficient only in that already admitted context. The application deadline is the previous day at five, not a promise of unlimited same-day admission. A decision to apply is not an accepted application.
grammar.example: 受付で名前を確認した後は、整理券さえあれば入れます。
grammar.translation: After the registration desk has confirmed your name, the admission ticket is enough to enter.

examples.ja: {受付|うけつけ}で{名前|なまえ}を{確認|かくにん}した{後|あと}は、{整理券|せいりけん}さえあれば{入|はい}れます。
examples.en: After the registration desk has confirmed your name, the admission ticket is enough to enter.

examples.ja: {前日|ぜんじつ}の{五時|ごじ}までに{応募|おうぼ}してください。
examples.en: Please apply by five on the preceding day.

examples.ja: {講座|こうざ}に{参加|さんか}しないなら、{応募|おうぼ}する{必要|ひつよう}はありません。
examples.en: If you will not take part in the lecture, you do not need to apply.

grammar.mistake: Keep the prior-admission context. By five is a deadline, not from five or until five continuously.

dialogues.title: Thursday’s article about Saturday
dialogues.scene: On Thursday, Bao asks Satō-sensei about an original fictional local-news article. Monday’s initial report announced a venue change caused by repairs. Saturday’s reading event is still future. Last year’s visitor figures are separate historical data.

lines.romaji: Sensei, chiiki no kiji o yomimashita. Midashi wa dokusho ibento no kaijō ga kawaru desu. Kyō wa mokuyōbi desu ne.
lines.meaning: Teacher, I read a local article. The headline is Reading event venue changes. Today is Thursday.

lines.romaji: Honbun ni wa, kōkyō no shisetsu no shūri no tame, getsuyōbi ni kaijō no henkō o kimeta to arimasu.
lines.meaning: The body says a venue change was decided Monday because the public facility needed repairs.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {月曜日|げつようび}の{速報|そくほう}でも{知|し}らせたそうです。{記者|きしゃ}が{取材|しゅざい}した{記事|きじ}では、{市役所|しやくしょ}の{隣|となり}の{施設|しせつ}を{使|つか}うとあります。
lines.romaji: Getsuyōbi no sokuhō de mo shiraseta sō desu. Kisha ga shuzai shita kiji de wa, shiyakusho no tonari no shisetsu o tsukau to arimasu.
lines.meaning: They reportedly announced it in Monday’s initial report too. The reporter’s article says they will use the facility next to city hall.

lines.speaker: Satō
lines.line: {報道|ほうどう}の{要点|ようてん}は{土曜日|どようび}の{場所|ばしょ}と{時間|じかん}です。{過去|かこ}の{出来事|できごと}と、これからの{予定|よてい}を{分|わ}けましょう。
lines.romaji: Hōdō no yōten wa doyōbi no basho to jikan desu. Kako no dekigoto to, kore kara no yotei o wakemashō.
lines.meaning: The report’s main details are Saturday’s location and time. Let us separate past events from future arrangements.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {台本|だいほん}の{朗読|ろうどく}や、{漫画|まんが}のコマもあるんですね。{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}しと{効果音|こうかおん}を{読|よ}む{練習|れんしゅう}に{使|つか}えそうです。
lines.romaji: Daihon no rōdoku ya, manga no koma mo arun desu ne. Fukidashi to kōkaon o yomu renshū ni tsukaesō desu.
lines.meaning: There will be a script reading and comic panels too. It looks useful for practising bubbles and effects.

lines.speaker: Satō
lines.line: {解釈|かいしゃく}の{前|まえ}に、{本文|ほんぶん}を{確|たし}かめてください。{製品|せいひん}の{仕様|しよう}を{読|よ}んだときと{同|おな}じです。{騒音|そうおん}が{変更|へんこう}の{理由|りゆう}とは{書|か}いてありません。
lines.romaji: Kaishaku no mae ni, honbun o tashikamete kudasai. Seihin no shiyō o yonda toki to onaji desu. Sōon ga henkō no riyū to wa kaite arimasen.
lines.meaning: Check the body before interpreting, just as with product specifications. It does not say noise was the reason for the change.

lines.speaker: You

lines.romaji: Kyonen no tōkei de wa, gozen ga sanjūnin, gogo ga nijūnin deshita. Kotoshi no ninzū de wa nai desu ne.
lines.meaning: Last year’s statistics show thirty morning visitors and twenty afternoon visitors. Those are not this year’s counts.

lines.romaji: Ototoshi no onaji ibento wa yonjūnin deshita. Kyonen wa jūnin zōka shimashita ga, kotoshi mo fueru to wa kagirimasen.
lines.meaning: The same event had forty visitors the year before. Last year increased by ten, but that does not mean this year will increase too.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {増加|ぞうか}か{減少|げんしょう}かを{言|い}うには、{同|おな}じ{範囲|はんい}の{数字|すうじ}を{比|くら}べるんですね。{見出|みだ}しだけで{判断|はんだん}しません。
lines.romaji: Zōka ka genshō ka o iu ni wa, onaji han'i no sūji o kuraberun desu ne. Midashi dake de handan shimasen.
lines.meaning: To say increase or decrease, we compare figures with the same scope. I will not judge from the headline alone.

lines.speaker: Satō
lines.line: その{通|とお}りです。{土曜日|どようび}の{予定|よてい}は、まだ{実施|じっし}された{出来事|できごと}ではありません。{条件|じょうけん}は{表|ひょう}でも{確認|かくにん}しましょう。
lines.romaji: Sono tōri desu. Doyōbi no yotei wa, mada jisshi sareta dekigoto de wa arimasen. Jōken wa hyō de mo kakunin shimashō.
lines.meaning: That is right. Saturday’s arrangement is not an event that has already happened. Check the conditions in the table too.

dialogues.title: Choose the activity and check the deadline
dialogues.scene: Still Thursday, Bao and Misaki consult the event table. Saturday’s free exhibition runs 9–12 with no application. The script-reading lecture runs 10–11:30, costs 300 yen, and admits the first twenty prior applicants; apply by Friday 17:00. Admitted applicants receive a ticket for the day. Last year’s counts total fifty. Bao chooses the exhibition, not the lecture.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {主催|しゅさい}は{地域|ちいき}の{読書|どくしょ}{会|かい}だね。{土曜日|どようび}に{展示|てんじ}と{講座|こうざ}を{開催|かいさい}することになったそうだよ。
lines.romaji: Shusai wa chiiki no dokushokai da ne. Doyōbi ni tenji to kōza o kaisai suru koto ni natta sō da yo.
lines.meaning: The organiser is the local reading group. They say an exhibition and a lecture have been arranged for Saturday.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {展示|てんじ}は{九時|くじ}から{十二時|じゅうにじ}まで、{無料|むりょう}。{講座|こうざ}は{十時|じゅうじ}から{十一時半|じゅういちじはん}まで、{三百円|さんびゃくえん}で{有料|ゆうりょう}だね。
lines.romaji: Tenji wa kuji kara jūniji made, muryō. Kōza wa jūji kara jūichiji han made, sanbyaku-en de yūryō da ne.
lines.meaning: The exhibition is free from nine to twelve. The lecture costs three hundred yen and runs from ten to eleven thirty.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {台本|だいほん}の{朗読|ろうどく}の{講座|こうざ}には{応募|おうぼ}が{必要|ひつよう}だよ。{定員|ていいん}は{先着|せんちゃく}{二十人|にじゅうにん}で、{前日|ぜんじつ}の{五時|ごじ}までに{申|もう}し{込|こ}むんだね。
lines.romaji: Daihon no rōdoku no kōza ni wa ōbo ga hitsuyō da yo. Teiin wa senchaku nijūnin de, zenjitsu no goji made ni mōshikomun da ne.
lines.meaning: The script-reading lecture requires an application. It takes the first twenty, and applications are due by five the preceding day.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {参加|さんか}が{決|き}まった{人|ひと}には{整理券|せいりけん}が{届|とど}くんだね。{当日|とうじつ}は{名前|なまえ}を{確認|かくにん}した{後|あと}、{整理券|せいりけん}さえあれば{入|はい}れるとある。
lines.romaji: Sanka ga kimatta hito ni wa seiriken ga todokun da ne. Tōjitsu wa namae o kakunin shita ato, seiriken sae areba haireru to aru.
lines.meaning: Accepted participants receive a ticket. It says that after the name check on the day, the ticket is enough for entry.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {翌日|よくじつ}の{日曜日|にちようび}は{開催|かいさい}しないよ。{価格|かかく}だけでなく、{時間|じかん}と{条件|じょうけん}も{読|よ}もう。
lines.romaji: Yokujitsu no nichiyōbi wa kaisai shinai yo. Kakaku dake de naku, jikan to jōken mo yomō.
lines.meaning: It will not be held on Sunday, the next day. Let us read not only the price but also the time and conditions.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: {集計|しゅうけい}した{去年|きょねん}の{人数|にんずう}は{合計|ごうけい}{五十人|ごじゅうにん}。{内訳|うちわけ}は{午前|ごぜん}{三十人|さんじゅうにん}と{午後|ごご}{二十人|にじゅうにん}だから、{午後|ごご}は{午前|ごぜん}ほど{多|おお}くなかったね。
lines.romaji: Shūkei shita kyonen no ninzū wa gōkei gojūnin. Uchiwake wa gozen sanjūnin to gogo nijūnin da kara, gogo wa gozen hodo ōku nakatta ne.
lines.meaning: Last year’s total was fifty. Thirty were in the morning and twenty in the afternoon, so the afternoon count was not as high.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {今年|ことし}の{講座|こうざ}の{定員|ていいん}も{二十人|にじゅうにん}だけど、{去年|きょねん}の{来場|らいじょう}{者|しゃ}とは{別|べつ}だね。{今|いま}は{減少|げんしょう}したとは{言|い}えないよ。
lines.romaji: Kotoshi no kōza no teiin mo nijūnin da kedo, kyonen no raijōsha to wa betsu da ne. Ima wa genshō shita to wa ienai yo.
lines.meaning: This year’s lecture capacity is also twenty, but it is different from last year’s visitor count. We cannot now say attendance decreased.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: コマの{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}しや{背景|はいけい}をじっと{読|よ}みたいから、{展示|てんじ}を{先|さき}に{見|み}ることにしたよ。
lines.romaji: Koma no fukidashi ya haikei o jitto yomitai kara, tenji o saki ni miru koto ni shita yo.
lines.meaning: I want to read the panel bubbles and backgrounds carefully, so I decided to see the exhibition first.

lines.speaker: Misaki
lines.line: {展示|てんじ}には{応募|おうぼ}がいらないね。{余白|よはく}や{台本|だいほん}の{解釈|かいしゃく}も{考|かんが}えよう。{前後|ぜんご}を{読|よ}む{練習|れんしゅう}になるよ。
lines.romaji: Tenji ni wa ōbo ga iranai ne. Yohaku ya daihon no kaishaku mo kangaeyō. Zengo o yomu renshū ni naru yo.
lines.meaning: The exhibition needs no application. Let us think about blank space and script interpretation too. It will be practice reading context.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: まだ{木曜日|もくようび}だから、{当日|とうじつ}に{行|い}ったわけではないね。{今日|きょう}は{条件|じょうけん}を{読|よ}んで、{展示|てんじ}を{選|えら}んだだけだ。
lines.romaji: Mada mokuyōbi da kara, tōjitsu ni itta wake de wa nai ne. Kyō wa jōken o yonde, tenji o eranda dake da.
lines.meaning: It is still Thursday, so I have not attended on the event day. Today I only read the conditions and chose the exhibition.

readings.title: A venue change, two activities and last year’s figures
paragraphs: {地域|ちいき}の{読書|どくしょ}{会|かい}は、{土曜日|どようび}のイベントの{会場|かいじょう}を{市役所|しやくしょ}の{隣|となり}に{変|か}えた。{公共|こうきょう}の{施設|しせつ}の{修理|しゅうり}のため、{月曜日|げつようび}に{変更|へんこう}を{決|き}め、{速報|そくほう}で{知|し}らせたという。{木曜日|もくようび}に{取材|しゅざい}した{記者|きしゃ}によると、{予定|よてい}の{時間|じかん}は{変|か}わらないそうだ。

{無料|むりょう}の{展示|てんじ}では{漫画|まんが}のコマと{台本|だいほん}を{読|よ}める。{有料|ゆうりょう}の{朗読|ろうどく}{講座|こうざ}は{先着|せんちゃく}{二十人|にじゅうにん}。{前日|ぜんじつ}{金曜日|きんようび}の{午後|ごご}{五時|ごじ}までに{応募|おうぼ}し、{参加|さんか}が{決|き}まった{人|ひと}は{当日|とうじつ}{整理券|せいりけん}を{持|も}っていく。{翌日|よくじつ}の{日曜日|にちようび}には{開催|かいさい}しない。

{去年|きょねん}の{統計|とうけい}は{午前|ごぜん}{三十人|さんじゅうにん}、{午後|ごご}{二十人|にじゅうにん}で、{合計|ごうけい}{五十人|ごじゅうにん}。{一昨年|おととし}の{四十人|よんじゅうにん}より{増加|ぞうか}した。この{内訳|うちわけ}は{過去|かこ}の{来場|らいじょう}{者|しゃ}であり、{今年|ことし}の{定員|ていいん}や{応募|おうぼ}{者|しゃ}の{数|かず}ではない。

head: {活動|かつどう}
{土曜日|どようび}の{時間|じかん}
{料金|りょうきん}
{条件|じょうけん}
rows: {九時|くじ}〜{十二時|じゅうにじ}
{十時|じゅうじ}〜{十一時半|じゅういちじはん}
{先着|せんちゃく}{二十人|にじゅうにん}、{前日|ぜんじつ}{午後|ごご}{五時|ごじ}までに{応募|おうぼ}

exercises.prompt: Why was the venue change decided?
options: A decrease in this year’s attendance
exercises.explain: The body gives repairs as the cause; Satō explicitly says noise was not stated.

exercises.prompt: What is already past on Thursday, and what remains future?
options: Monday’s venue decision is past; Saturday’s event is future
exercises.explain: Satō distinguishes the decision from the still future event.

exercises.prompt: What do the thirty and twenty figures describe?
options: Last year’s morning and afternoon visitors
exercises.explain: They are explicitly last year’s statistics, not this year’s count.

exercises.context: Form practice: report the noun predicate 無料だ with そうです, retaining だ.
exercises.line: {記事|きじ}によると、{展示|てんじ}は{無料|むりょう}＿＿そうです。
exercises.explain: Reported noun predicates retain だ. This is a source report, not stem appearance.

exercises.context: Form practice: connect 修理 as a noun cause before ため.
exercises.line: {施設|しせつ}の{修理|しゅうり}＿＿ため、{会場|かいじょう}を{変|か}えた。
exercises.explain: Nouns take の before causal ため; the named cause is repairs.

exercises.context: Reply politely to Satō-sensei. Keep the stated cause and check the body.
exercises.line: {騒音|そうおん}が{会場|かいじょう}を{変|か}えた{理由|りゆう}だと{言|い}えますか。
options: いいえ。{本文|ほんぶん}では{修理|しゅうり}のためだとあります。{解釈|かいしゃく}の{前|まえ}に、{見出|みだ}しだけでなく{本文|ほんぶん}を{確認|かくにん}します。
はい。{騒音|そうおん}が{原因|げんいん}だと{取材|しゅざい}で{必|かなら}ず{分|わ}かりました。
はい。{土曜日|どようび}のイベントにはもう{行|い}きました。
exercises.explain: The first follows the reported repair cause and polite context; the other replies invent a cause or attendance.

exercises.meaning: According to the article’s main text, you can read comic panels and speech bubbles on Saturday.
tiles: {記事|きじ}の{本文|ほんぶん}によると、
コマと{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}しを
exercises.explain: The source report stays attached to the future opportunity; it does not say the learner has already attended.

exercises.prompt: What does Bao choose, without attending yet?
options: The free exhibition to read panels carefully
Sunday’s session at a new venue
exercises.explain: Bao chooses the exhibition; it is still Thursday.

exercises.prompt: When must a lecture application be made?
options: By Friday five in the afternoon, the preceding day
Any time Sunday with no capacity limit
exercises.explain: The deadline is 前日の五時までに for Saturday’s lecture.

exercises.prompt: Why does the capacity of twenty not establish an attendance decrease?
options: Capacity is a limit; last year’s fifty is completed attendance
Twenty is always greater than fifty
The table has no activity names
exercises.explain: Misaki explicitly distinguishes the quantities and the periods.

exercises.context: Form practice: describe your own choice with dictionary 見る + ことにした.
exercises.line: {展示|てんじ}を{先|さき}に＿＿ことにした。
exercises.explain: The construction takes a dictionary-form action. A past choice is not completed attendance.

exercises.context: Form practice: mark an application deadline, not a continuous duration, with までに.
exercises.line: {前日|ぜんじつ}の{午後|ごご}{五時|ごじ}＿＿{応募|おうぼ}する。
exercises.explain: までに marks the latest completion time; from five or during five does not give this deadline.

exercises.context: Reply casually to Misaki. You only intend to read the free exhibition’s panels.
exercises.line: {講座|こうざ}に{応募|おうぼ}しないと、コマの{展示|てんじ}も{見|み}られないの？
options: ううん。{無料|むりょう}の{展示|てんじ}には{応募|おうぼ}がいらないから、コマや{背景|はいけい}を{読|よ}めるよ。
うん。{展示|てんじ}も{必|かなら}ず{三百円|さんびゃくえん}だよ。
うん。{日曜日|にちようび}だけは{応募|おうぼ}がいらないよ。
exercises.explain: The exhibition and lecture have distinct entry rules. The other replies transfer the lecture charge or invent Sunday opening.

exercises.meaning: On the day, after your registered name is checked, the admission ticket is enough to enter.
tiles: {名前|なまえ}を{確認|かくにん}した{後|あと}は、
{整理券|せいりけん}さえあれば
exercises.explain: This sufficient-condition statement retains the registered-name context; it does not grant unlimited unregistered entry.

exercises.prompt: You can visit only Saturday 9–9:30 and want no charge. Which activity fits?
exercises.explain: The table lists the exhibition from 9–12, free; lecture starts 10 and costs 300 yen.

exercises.prompt: What was last year’s total, and its change from the year before?
options: Fifty visitors; an increase of ten
Twenty visitors; a decrease of thirty
exercises.explain: Thirty plus twenty is fifty; the preceding year was forty. Capacity is separate.

exercises.prompt: Which reader must apply by the stated Friday deadline?
options: Someone seeking the Saturday script-reading lecture
Someone only visiting the free display
exercises.explain: The lecture alone requires the first-twenty application; Sunday is not held.

exercises.prompt: What changed in Monday’s decision, according to Thursday’s article?
options: The venue; the scheduled time did not change
The scheduled time; the venue stayed fixed
The past visitor tally; all activities became free
exercises.explain: The first paragraph specifies venue change due to repairs and unchanged times.

watch.prompt: Optionally read a current notice from your own media. Record its source, date, event time, conditions and what is still unknown.
